checks.result: Source-reviewed: a successful lookup removes and appends the entry without changing costs; a miss returns before mutation. Count-based admission removes index zero, preserving least-recently-used eviction.

checks.check: Independent count, pixel and mask limits
checks.result: Source-reviewed: positive immutable limits; insertion evicts while count is at capacity or either independently computed remaining byte budget is insufficient. Tests include separate pixel and mask pressure and mixed production-sized payloads.

Source-reviewed: admitted replacements remove the old entry and both cost charges before evaluating other evictions, then append as most recent. Smaller and larger replacements have corresponding regression assertions.

Source-reviewed: negative or individually oversized pixel/mask costs return false before key lookup/removal, so rejection preserves old value, costs, and recency. Tests inspect both replacement and new-key rejections, Int.min/Int.max boundaries, and subsequent eviction without lookup disturbing the original cache.

Source-reviewed: guarding 0 <= incoming <= maximum makes maximum - incoming safe. Eviction leaves existing totals <= that remainder before addition; therefore resulting totals remain representable and <= each maximum, including Int.max. Removal subtracts an included nonnegative charge. No capacity reservation occurs for Int.max maximumCount.

Source-reviewed: reverse-index removal avoids shifted-index errors, subtracts both byte charges, and preserves survivor ordering. Full removal, empty removal, reuse, and later survivor eviction are asserted.
